scripts.test:db:ci: if [ -z "$CI" ]; then echo 'Skipping migration-backed database tests outside CI.'; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p playwright-report; log=playwright-report/database-ci.log; : > "$log"; if [ ! -f supabase/config.toml ]; then npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 init >> "$log" 2>&1 || { cat "$log"; exit 1; }; fi; npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 stop --no-backup >> "$log" 2>&1 || true; { npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 db start && npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 test db; } >> "$log" 2>&1; status=$?; npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 stop --no-backup >> "$log" 2>&1; cleanup_status=$?; cat "$log"; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; exit $cleanup_status
scripts.verify: npm run test:run && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:db:ci
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e:workflow
